title: 1.2 Billion People Use AI Every Week. Almost None Own It.

delivery_structure.value: Line-delivered report, contiguous windows, aphoristic close, silent bridge: dateline (L1, 2.20–4.86 s) → number statement (L2, 4.86–7.68 s) → repetition-with-emphasis restatement (L3, 7.68–12.64 s: 'Not tried it once. Used it — this week.') → the turn (L4, 12.64–16.46 s: 'the part nobody counts') → mechanism, the longest line (L5, 16.46–23.98 s: the chat box as thinnest harness) → three-clause aphoristic close (L6, 23.98–28.006 s: 'Adoption is total. Ownership is zero.') → silent bridge card (28.833–30.848 s, bed only) → outro to 34.348 s. Words: phrases of ≤3 words, cumulative arrival at the spoken moment, completed phrase HOLDS while the next reveals and clears when the phrase after next starts (C-05), in two alternating lower bands (centres y=1290/1410), at most 6 words on screen at once. The locked line windows are contiguous — no inter-line silence gaps are built into the narration windows; the only designed silences are the 0.827 s before the bridge and the bridge itself.
delivery_structure.rationale: The delivery pattern is the one the delivered artifact demonstrably performs: the locked transcript's line windows, DR-WORD-3's phrase system and DR-BRIDGE's bridge schedule are all in-package records, and the narration's beat order (dateline → number → restatement → turn → mechanism → aphoristic close) is the story_structure's own payoff schedule rendered as delivery. Decided as the delivery structure of record: the pattern below is measured off the delivered artifact itself (locked line windows, phrase system and gap schedule all in this package's own records) — it ratifies the delivery the piece actually has. No separate researched pause-map / Stage-2 delivery pass was ever performed for this piece; a future delivery retrofit amends this field by a new dated decision, it does not silently overwrite it.

No physical split into separate HTML/CSS/JS files is performed — the single-file form is itself a recorded decision (DR-CONTAINER, H-01: the MP4 renders from this file alone).
scene_decomposition.rationale: Every compartment is named from the shipped file's own DOM ids and its DEC records, counted in the package's element coverage (44/44); the single-file retention follows DR-CONTAINER's H-01 rationale, so the decomposition records what the artifact IS, not a rebuild plan.
